display_name: Zero-knob London–NY overlap long, intraday flat
hypothesis: On XAUUSD H1, a fixed long-only participation in the broker-server London–NY overlap window extracts positive expectancy after Standard STP spread costs because liquidity and directional follow-through cluster in that session; the rule has zero free parameters so null max-stat tests the session claim rather than a search.

instrument.multi_symbol_blocked_reason: Only XAU historical CSV with spread exists; multi-instrument is future work

rule.entry: At most one long per calendar day: enter at the close of the first H1 bar whose server hour is in entry_hours and which is the session open bar (hour == entry_hours[0]) if flat.
rule.server_clock: as stamped in xauusd_data.csv time column (broker/server)
rule.dst_policy: Hours are fixed integers on the stored server clock; no local DST conversion. If broker DST shifts the wall clock, the rule still uses numeric hour fields as stored — accepted fixed mapping for this freeze.
rule.exit: Intraday flat: force close at the close of the last bar with hour==16 same day, or on SL/TP if hit earlier. No overnight holds → swap not charged.

null.notes: Session thesis: preserve intra-day OHLC path and hour structure by shuffling whole calendar days. Global return shuffle is FORBIDDEN for this family because it destroys session geometry.

kill.after_kill: stop; new family_id + new charter freeze required

explicitly_forbidden: free any knob without new charter version
inspect real-grid then edit code before null completes
attach this family work to PR #1 without separate review
